name: Ground Zero
description: Halden's barley went to Ashgate's food depot, and in the dark it germinated. Get the mill running, take samples for Dr Vey, burn what is growing in the silos and blow the depot before the spores reach the river.
briefing: Three weeks ago Halden Agritech sprayed a blight called BRIAR on the fields round Ashgate to kill crop pests. The barley went to the food depot, the food went to the town, and the town stopped being a town.

The army has drawn a line round it: the Rotline. You are Lantern section, and your first job is where it started. The depot's silos are still full of BRIAR grain, and the mould in them is putting out spores.

Start the mill's generator so the ventilation clears the dust, take four live cultures for Dr Vey, burn the growths in the silo bay, then rig the central silo and run. Kestrel lifts off the rail apron in twelve minutes.
debrief: The depot is a column of smoke you can see from Harrow. Dr Vey has her cultures. She says now she knows what Marlowe sprayed, she can start to undo it.

objectives.label: Start the mill generator to clear the dust

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Lantern, Okafor. The depot's ventilation has been dead for two weeks and the grain dust in there is explosive, choked with BRIAR mould. Get the mill generator up before anyone fires a flare.
radio.done: Fans are turning and the lights are on. The warehouse gate is open.

objectives.label: Collect four live grain cultures in the warehouse

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: Dr Vey. I need those cultures intact: if I don't know exactly which variant Marlowe sprayed, I can't make anything to stop it. Four canisters, from the processing chutes.
radio.done: Four cultures. That's it. That's what they sprayed.

objectives.label: Burn the three growths in the silo bay

radio.speaker: Wren
radio.start: Wren. Those aren't grain sacks in the silo bay any more, they're breathing. Each one's full of crawlers. Light them up and be ready when they split.
radio.done: That's the last of them. The bay's clear.

objectives.label: Rig the central silo and get clear

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Thermite on the central silo's pressure junction. Keep the dead off it for thirty-five seconds, then be out of that red ring: the whole silo is going up.
radio.done: There she goes!

objectives.label: Outrun the firestorm to the rail dock

radio.speaker: Wren
radio.start: The dust caught! The whole milling floor is burning and it's coming east. Rail dock, now!
radio.done: You're out of it.

objectives.label: Board Kestrel's transport on the apron

radio.speaker: Kestrel
radio.start: Kestrel. I'm down on the apron south of the dock. Forty-five seconds and I'm gone with or without you!

objectives.label: Optional: put down 180
Optional: burn the depot's own nests

notes.title: Dispatch sheet
notes.text: Barley, Halden trial fields, 40 tonnes, into silos 1 to 6. Halden rep says no turning, no airing, straight to the mill. Lads say it smells sweet, like bread. Lads say the silo doors are warm to touch. I've told them it's the sun.

notes.title: Quality log, last page
notes.text: Batch 14: germination in storage. Hyphae through 80% of the grain. Spore load beyond scale. Recommend incineration. (Second hand:) Recommendation declined by the Ministry. Batch released to the mill.

notes.title: Chalked on a rail wagon
notes.text: DON'T OPEN. Wagon 6 is full of the stuff and it's moving. We stopped loading. The driver went to find the foreman and didn't come back. If you're reading this, the road gate is quicker.

name: Dead River
description: Old Town is cut off, and the evacuation has no fuel. Free the mechanics in the church crypt, get the stranded tanker running and walk it to the river while the drawbridge comes down.
briefing: The evacuation out of Ashgate runs on diesel, and the last full tanker is stranded in Old Town's square, north of the river. Its crew bricked themselves into the church crypt when the town turned.

Break the crypt wall, get the mechanics to the tanker and keep the dead off it while they fix the steering. Then walk it down to the stone bridge: it crawls, and it stops dead the moment one of them gets a hand on it.

The bridge is raised. Its winch is on the north bank. Brutes have been seen crossing the shallows. South of the river, a pack of Screamers is roosting on the petrol station forecourt, among the pumps.
debrief: The tanker is over the river and the evacuation has its fuel. Old Town's petrol station is a crater. Hollis says that is one way to take out a nest.

objectives.label: Break into the crypt and bring the mechanics to the tanker

radio.speaker: Tom
radio.start: This is Tom, tanker crew! We're bricked into the crypt under the church, me and Elena. Knock the wall through at the back of the nave. The tanker's fine, it's the steering.
radio.done: We're at the tanker. Elena's under it already.

objectives.label: Keep them off the tanker while the steering is fixed

radio.speaker: Tom
radio.start: Hold E on her and patch what you can while Elena does the steering. They can smell the diesel, here they come!
radio.done: She steers! Get in front of her, we're going to the bridge.

objectives.label: Walk the tanker down to the stone bridge

radio.speaker: Tom
radio.start: She goes at a walk and only with you round her. One of them gets a hand on the tank and she stops dead. Keep her clean!
radio.done: We're at the bridgehead. The bridge is up.

objectives.label: Hold the bridge winch while the drawbridge comes down

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Okafor. The winch is grinding and every one of them heard it. Fifty seconds. And there's a Brute crossing the shallows straight for the console: whoever has the big gun, hold that bridgehead!
radio.done: Bridge is down. Tanker's rolling over.

objectives.label: Kill the Screamers roosting on the petrol station forecourt

radio.speaker: Wren
radio.start: Wren. Three Screamers on the petrol station forecourt, and every scream brings another street. They're sitting among the fuel barrels. Your call.
radio.done: Forecourt's quiet. Well. It's on fire, but it's quiet.

objectives.label: Fall back through the park gates

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Trucks are at the park gates, south-west. Fifty seconds, Lantern.

objectives.label: Optional: put down 150
Optional: crack the old mill's strongroom safe

notes.title: On the crypt wall
notes.text: Day 2 under the church. Tom says the steering rack went when we hit the fountain. 9,000 litres of clean diesel sitting in the square and nobody to drive it. If the army comes, the bridge winch is on the north bank. Somebody raised it to keep them out. It didn't.

notes.title: Mill ledger
notes.text: Halden contract: grind the trial barley here, no other grain on the stones that week. Flour to the Harrow ring road supermarket, free of charge. "Promotional." The miller's cough has not gone. Neither has the smell.

notes.title: Petrol station till roll
notes.text: They come for the lights. I turned the forecourt lights off and they still come. Something on the roof screams and they all come running. I've got the barrels lined up round the pumps. One match. If you see this, I didn't get to light it.

name: Blackout Protocol
description: Ashgate's power plant has tripped, and the quarantine wards in Harrow have gone dark. Find the breaker keycard, restart the switchyard, hold the capacitor ring with your kit jammed and run before the substation goes up.
briefing: Dr Vey has eleven patients in Harrow General who caught BRIAR and did not turn: the first her serum kept alive. They are on machines. The machines run off Ashgate's power plant, and the plant has gone dark.

There are no lights inside. Use your weapon lights. The breaker keycard is somewhere in the supervisors' offices by the gate. Each generator you restart in the switchyard lights a floodlight and wakes a turret.

The capacitor ring has to be held while it charges, and its field kills every battery near it: your kit will be dead. Something big has been seen in the turbine hall. Bielak, the last engineer, is on the radio.
debrief: Harrow General's wards are lit again. Eleven patients, eleven heartbeats. The substation is a crater. Bielak says he never liked it anyway.

objectives.label: Search the supervisors' offices for the breaker keycard

radio.speaker: Wren
radio.start: Wren. Pitch black in there. Keep your lights up: I can hear clicking in the ceiling ducts. The keycard's in one of the supervisors' desks.
radio.done: Got it. The fence gate is open.

objectives.label: Restart the three generators in the switchyard

radio.speaker: Bielak
radio.start: Bielak, shift engineer, the last one. Three generators in the yard. Every one you start lights a floodlight and wakes a turret.
radio.done: All three. Look at that yard light up!

objectives.label: Hold the capacitor ring while it charges

radio.speaker: Bielak
radio.start: The ring is charging, and the field off it fries anything with a battery: your kit is dead till it's done. Guns and grenades. Forty seconds!
radio.done: Charged! The control gate is open. And something just tore a turbine off its mount.

objectives.label: Put down the arc-burnt Brute in the turbine hall

radio.speaker: Bielak
radio.start: It was a fitter. It got into the switchgear and it's been sparking ever since. It's got a pack running with it. Big gun, its back, keep moving.
radio.done: It's down. And the substation's gone critical behind you!

objectives.label: Outrun the arc flash past the cooling towers

radio.speaker: Bielak
radio.start: The substation is rupturing and the whole yard is on fire, and it's coming through the hall! Out past the cooling towers!
radio.done: You're clear. That was close.

objectives.label: Make the highway outpost

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Okafor. Trucks at the highway outpost, north-east corner. Forty-five seconds.

objectives.label: Optional: thin them out
Optional: burn the nests in the switchyard

notes.title: Shift log, night 9
notes.text: Cooling water intake clogged again. Pulled it up: not weed. White threads, warm to the touch, growing back as you cut them. Halden's contract says the plant feeds their Harrow site first, always, even over the hospital. Day shift didn't come in. Night shift is me.

notes.title: Memo pinned in the control room
notes.text: PRIORITY SUPPLY. In any shortfall, load shedding is to follow the Halden schedule: Halden Harrow site, Ministry, Harrow General, residential. This instruction supersedes local emergency procedure. Questions to Minister Marlowe's office.

notes.title: Under the guard's chair
notes.text: Bricked the door myself. Got biscuits, water, the radio. Heard the army say they're drawing a line round the whole district and calling it the Rotline. Funny name for a cemetery. If the lights come on again, someone came for us. Leave the biscuits.

name: The Crossroads
description: The evacuation train is crossing Ashgate's outer ring with Mila Pryce aboard, and the dead are pouring in down all four streets. Wake the miniguns, haul the ammunition, hold the square and keep the radio relay alive.

objectives.label: Start the generators that wake the square's miniguns

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Lantern, Okafor. Those miniguns are your lifeline. Church courtyard and the lot behind the garage: get both generators running.
radio.done: Both guns are up and tracking. Here comes the first of them.

objectives.label: Haul the three ammunition crates from the pharmacy

radio.speaker: Sgt Briggs
radio.start: Briggs. Three crates of ammunition in the pharmacy on the east street. They're heavy: whoever carries one has a pistol and nothing else. The rest of you, walk with them.
radio.done: That's all three. Now we can hold.

objectives.label: Hold the square against the north surge

radio.speaker: Wren
radio.start: Wren, on the flats. They're coming down the north street like a river. Hold the sandbags! Weld the shop doors if you want them in the minigun's lanes.
radio.done: Surge is broken. The train's halfway.

objectives.label: Patch up the radio relay in the square

radio.speaker: Kestrel
radio.start: Kestrel. I can't find my corridor without that relay, and it's in pieces. Fix it and I'll get you out of there.
radio.done: Relay's up. I hear you. Hold it till the train is through.

objectives.label: Keep the relay standing while the train gets through

radio.speaker: Wren
radio.start: Two Brutes, south and west streets, both coming for the relay! Shock traps on the corners, use them!
radio.done: Train's through! Every carriage!

objectives.label: Fall back to the armoured carrier on the north street

radio.speaker: Sgt Briggs
radio.start: Carrier's at the top of the north street. Forty seconds, then we roll.

objectives.label: Optional: put down 250

briefing: Every survivor the Rotline found is on one train, crawling round Ashgate's outer ring. Among them is Mila Pryce, nine, bitten three weeks ago and never turned. Dr Vey says Mila's blood may be the whole cure.

The line runs past the Crossroads, and everything dead in Ashgate is coming down the four streets toward the noise. Hold the square. Two miniguns face the north and south streets, wired to generators in the church courtyard and behind the garage.
There is ammunition in the looted pharmacy, and a radio relay in the square that Kestrel needs to find her corridor. Two Brutes are coming in from the south and west. Give the train five minutes.
debrief: The train is through, every carriage. Mila waved at the window. The Crossroads is a wall of bodies four deep. Sgt Briggs says the motor pool is next, and it is worse.

notes.title: Railway notice
notes.text: Evacuation service. One train. All carriages. Passengers will not be inspected (by order of Major Okafor, over the Ministry's objection). Bring nothing. Children first. Dogs if they are quiet.

notes.title: Note on the pharmacy counter
notes.text: The army took the morphine and left the ammunition. Funny world. Three crates in the back for whoever holds the square. I gave the last of the antibiotics to the Pryce girl's mum. Half the town says the child should be shot. The other half says she's why we'll live.

notes.title: Pew card
notes.text: Rang the bell to call people in. It called the dead in. Rang it again to call the army. It called more dead. Not ringing it a third time. The generator in the yard works the lights and the guns on the square. God forgive us, we are grateful for the guns.

name: Iron Maw
description: The army's line at the motor pool collapsed when its own column turned inside the wire. Retake the depots, get the armoured carrier running, drive it to the north gate and blow your way out of Ashgate.

objectives.label: Take back the fuel depot and the watchtower

radio.speaker: Sgt Briggs
radio.start: Briggs. The fuel depot on the west side and the watchtower on the east. Stand in each till my lads have them. They'll try to take them back.
radio.done: Both ours. Now the carrier.

objectives.label: Get the armoured carrier running

radio.speaker: Sgt Briggs
radio.start: The carrier in the middle has its engine half out. Hold E on her and get her going, and don't let them chew the tyres off while you do.
radio.done: She's running. Just about.

objectives.label: Walk the carrier to the north gate

radio.speaker: Sgt Briggs
radio.start: She goes at a walk and stops dead if they get on her. Keep her clean all the way to the gate.
radio.done: At the gate. Get the charge off her.

objectives.label: Blow the north gate with the carrier's charge

radio.speaker: Sgt Briggs
radio.start: Charge on the gate. Twenty-five seconds and it'll be loud. Keep them off it and get back past the red!
radio.done: Gate's gone! And look what was waiting behind it.

objectives.label: Put down the commander in his armour

radio.speaker: Wren
radio.start: That's the column commander. Still in his plate. Shoot past it: his back, his legs, anything it doesn't cover.
radio.done: He's down. Road's open.

objectives.label: Out through the breached gate

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Okafor. Everyone through the gate and onto the road. The fire teams go in behind you.

objectives.label: Optional: put down 250
Optional: start the generators that wake the turrets

briefing: This is the end of Ashgate. The motor pool was the army's last fortified line, and it fell from inside: the column's own crews turned in their trucks. The north gate is welded shut behind them.
Take back the fuel depot and the watchtower, then get the armoured carrier in the middle of the yard running. It is the only thing left with a breaching charge.
Walk it to the north gate (it stops dead if they climb on it), blow the gate and put down the commander, who is still wearing his armour. After that, the order is to burn the town.
debrief: The gate is scrap and the column is out. Ashgate is burning behind you. The Rotline is Harrow's problem now. So are you.

notes.title: Requisition, stamped DENIED
notes.text: Request: 400 litres diesel, 12 trucks, medical kit for 300 civilians. Denied: fuel and vehicles are reserved for Halden Agritech evacuation (Ministry order 14). Briggs' note in the margin: we are taking them anyway. Court-martial me in Harrow.

notes.title: An unsent letter
notes.text: Mum. The column turned last night. Our own lads, in the trucks. The commander locked the north gate so nothing could get out, and then he was one of the things that couldn't get out. The carrier still runs. Nobody wants to go near it.

notes.title: Orders, in the quartermaster's bunker
notes.text: In the event the Rotline cannot be held at Ashgate, all Halden Agritech material is to be destroyed in place and the town denied to the infection by fire. Civilian evacuation is not to delay this order. Signed, E. Marlowe.

name: Ghost Fleet
description: Before Harrow's harbour was sealed, Halden loaded a barge with dry spore powder for export. Find the manifest, get the crane crews out, seal the north road and sink the barge at its pier.
briefing: Harrow, the city past the Rotline. Its harbour was quarantined a week ago, but not before Halden Agritech loaded an export barge at Pier 2 with three containers of dried BRIAR spores. Destination: not declared.
The manifest drive is in one of the customs containers in the sorting yard. Two crane operators have been pinned on their gantries since the harbour fell.
The crane can drop a container across the north road and cut off half of what is coming. Then charge the barge's bilge valves and get off the pier. Something enormous has been seen on the main quay.
debrief: The barge is on the bottom of the harbour with its cargo, and the manifest is on its way to Dr Vey. It names a buyer: the Ministry. Okafor read it twice.

objectives.label: Search the customs containers for the manifest drive

radio.speaker: Wren
radio.start: Wren. The containers are stacked four high: it's an echo chamber. Watch the corners between the rows. The customs ones have the yellow tape.
radio.done: Drive's in the bag.

objectives.label: Get the crane operators down and back to the camp

radio.speaker: Dan
radio.start: Dan, crane two, and Sarah's on crane three. We've been up here four days. The ladder's thick with them. Clear the bottom and we'll come down.
radio.done: We're down. I can run the crane from the console if you hold it.

objectives.label: Hold the crane console while it drops a container across the north road

radio.speaker: Dan
radio.start: Lifting now. Forty-five seconds to swing it over the north road, and the whole yard can hear the motor. Keep them off me!
radio.done: Container's down! North road's shut.

objectives.label: Charge the barge's bilge valves and get off the pier

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Okafor. Charge on the valves, then off the pier: the blast reaches fourteen metres and the pier is narrow. Thirty-five seconds.
radio.done: She's going down. Good riddance.

objectives.label: Put down the colossus on the main quay

radio.speaker: Wren
radio.start: The big one on the quay just watched its barge sink, and it's angry. Crawlers all round it.
radio.done: It's in the water. Harbour master's pad, go.

objectives.label: Get to Kestrel at the harbour master's office

radio.speaker: Kestrel
radio.start: Kestrel. Down outside the harbour master's office. Forty-five seconds!

objectives.label: Optional: put down 200

notes.title: Customs slip
notes.text: Halden Agritech. 3 × 40ft, "agricultural powder". Export licence: Ministry of Reconstruction, signed E. Marlowe. Destination field left blank. Inspection waived. The inspector has been told to take a week off.

notes.title: Scratched into a crane cab
notes.text: Day 4. Dan's on two, I can see his torch. They climb the ladders but they fall off. We dropped a container on twenty of them on day 1. Could do it again if anyone held the console.

notes.title: Harbour master's log
notes.text: Barge loaded at Pier 2 under armed guard. I asked what was in it. The guard said seed. Seed does not need a guard. Barge did not sail: the crew turned at the moorings. Sealed my strongroom. Left the key on the hook. Nobody will need it now.

name: The Glass Labyrinth
description: Harrow's botanical gardens were Halden's open-air test ground, and where patient zero caught it. Take the lake pumps, search the hedge maze, hold the gazebo and blow your way into the palm house for what is nesting in its dome.
briefing: Harrow's Victorian gardens were commandeered by Halden Agritech for open-air trials of BRIAR. The plants are dead. The gardener, Arthur Penn, was the first person it ever turned: patient zero.

Halden dumped its runoff in the lake. Take back the three drainage pumps before it soaks the gardens, then search the coolers in the hedge maze for their test data. The maze is all blind corners: bring something short and loud.
Hold the gazebo on the island while the data uploads. The palm house is barred: blow its south door. Something has been screaming from inside the dome for a week.
debrief: The palm house is glass on the gravel and the thing in its dome is dead. Halden's test data names every trial they ran. The last line reads: subject PENN, transferred to project LANTERN.

objectives.label: Take the three lake drainage pumps

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: Dr Vey. Halden dumped its runoff in that lake. If the pumps stay flooded the whole garden soaks. West shore, north shore, east shore: stand on each till it runs.
radio.done: All three pumps running. The water's going down.

objectives.label: Search the research coolers in the hedge maze

radio.speaker: Wren
radio.start: Wren. The maze is all blind corners and they're in the hedges. Shotguns, flamers, anything short. The coolers are from the research tents.
radio.done: Got the telemetry.

objectives.label: Hold the island gazebo while the data uploads

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: Get on the island. The gazebo has the only signal in the garden, and it takes forty-five seconds to send. Swells coming down the causeway: pop them early and they take their friends with them.
radio.done: Sent. All of it.

objectives.label: Blow the palm house's barred south door

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Okafor. The palm house is barred from the inside. Charge on the south door, twenty seconds, then stand back.
radio.done: Door's gone. Listen to that.

objectives.label: Kill the Screamer nesting in the dome

radio.speaker: Wren
radio.start: It's up in the dome among the palms, and every scream brings crawlers out of the beds. Kill it and the garden goes quiet.
radio.done: It's dead. The garden's quiet.

objectives.label: Back out through the main gate

radio.speaker: Kestrel
radio.start: Kestrel. Down at the main gate. Forty seconds.

objectives.label: Optional: put down 200
Optional: start the boiler room generator to power the promenade traps

notes.title: In the gardener's cottage
notes.text: The Halden men sprayed the beds again. Told me to wear the mask. Masks are for the rose dust, I said, I've been at this forty years. Hands itching tonight. Spots on the backs of them, white, like mildew. Minister's coming Tuesday to see the trial. I'll wash before.

notes.title: A whiteboard in the maze
notes.text: TRIAL 7: aerosol, 40 m spread, wind SW. Plots A to D dead by day 3. Wildlife: rats, crows, one fox, mobile after death. (Below, in another pen:) Gardener exposed. Do NOT inform Dr Vey. Minister informed.

notes.title: Boiler room notice
notes.text: The old boiler generator still works the promenade lights and the electric fence round the lake walk. Start it for the evening events. Do not start it if there are visitors on the fence. (Scrawled:) There are no visitors any more.

name: Contagion Ward
description: Harrow General's containment wing holds the original blood samples from patient zero, and its generators are failing. Clear the atrium, take the samples, save the ICU's air, hold the isolation ward and get out ahead of the purge gas.
briefing: Harrow General: the hospital whose wards Blackout kept alive. Its containment wing holds the blood drawn from Arthur Penn, patient zero, before Halden took him away. Dr Vey needs it unmutated.

The backup generators are failing and the morgue doors have given way. Clear the atrium, collect four frozen samples from the pathology labs, then mend the ICU's air scrubber before the ward suffocates.
Isolation Ward 3 has to be held while it decontaminates: the mist jams your kit. When it finishes, the wing vents purge gas down the south corridor. Be ahead of it.
debrief: Penn's samples are in Dr Vey's cold box and every patient on the ward is breathing. In the bottom of the sample case was a Ministry seal and one word: LANTERN.

objectives.label: Clear the triage atrium

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: Dr Vey. The atrium is full of them, and there are Screamers among them: kill those first, before they wake the wings.
radio.done: Atrium's clear. North corridor's open.

objectives.label: Collect four frozen samples from the pathology labs

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: Those vials hold Penn's blood from before it mutated. Keep them cold. Four will do.
radio.done: Four samples. The east corridor is open.

objectives.label: Mend the ICU's air scrubber

radio.speaker: Sr Malik
radio.start: Sister Malik, ICU. The scrubber is failing and my patients are breathing what the dead breathe out. Hold E on it. They're coming up the lift shafts!
radio.done: Air's clean. The south corridor is open.

objectives.label: Hold Isolation Ward 3 while it decontaminates

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: The decontamination mist jams anything electronic: no kit for forty-five seconds. And when it's done, the wing purges.
radio.done: Done. Now go: the purge is starting!

objectives.label: Get up the south corridor ahead of the purge gas

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: Gas in the south wing! Up the corridor, through the atrium, don't stop!
radio.done: You're ahead of it.

objectives.label: Out through the ambulance bay

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Okafor. Ambulance bay, everyone. Forty seconds.

objectives.label: Optional: put down 250
Optional: burn the nests in the morgue

notes.title: Night nurse's notes
notes.text: Bed 4 sat up and asked for tea. Bed 4 has had BRIAR for nineteen days. Dr Vey's serum, third dose. The lesions are drying. I have been nursing for thirty years and I sat down in the corridor and laughed.

notes.title: Patient file, sealed
notes.text: Patient zero. Arthur Penn, 61, gardener, Harrow Botanical Gardens. Admitted with lesions after handling a test crop. Blood drawn and frozen. Transferred to Halden custody, project LANTERN, by order of Minister Marlowe. Not to be discussed with Dr Vey.

notes.title: A dog-eared notebook
notes.text: Beacon section, atrium. Lights out at 0200. Something in the walls. If you're the next team: they come from the ducts, not the doors. Keep your backs to the pillars. Tell my sister I said the thing I never said.

name: The Traitor's Fall
description: Minister Edwin Marlowe signed BRIAR's field trials, and he holds the codes to Halden's sealed lab. He is locked in the safe room of his sealed house. Blow the doors, put down his guards, find the override and drag him to the helipad.
briefing: Edwin Marlowe, Minister for Reconstruction, approved BRIAR's field trials a year ahead of Dr Vey's safety tests and ran something called LANTERN behind her back. He is the only man alive with the codes to Halden's sealed lab under the metro.

He sealed his house on the hill when the dead came up the drive. Every door is barred. His private guards turned inside, in their vests. The safe room override is hidden somewhere in the study, the library or the cellar.

Blow the front doors, find the override, walk him to the helipad on the lawn and light the pad's four corners for Kestrel. Something big lives in the hedges. Nine minutes before the chopper turns back.
debrief: Marlowe is aboard and he gave up the codes before the skids left the grass. He didn't say sorry. Okafor didn't ask him to.

objectives.label: Blow the barred front doors

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Okafor. Every door in that house is barred from inside. Charge on the front doors, eighteen seconds, and it will wake everything in there.
radio.done: You're in. So is the noise.

objectives.label: Put down the minister's guards

radio.speaker: Marlowe
radio.start: Stay back! I'm sealed in with enough food for a year! The government authorised BRIAR, you have no jurisdiction here! My guards will... my guards...
radio.done: Is anyone there? Are they gone?

objectives.label: Find the safe room override: study, library or cellar

radio.speaker: Marlowe
radio.start: The override? It's... it's hidden. The study, or the library. Or the cellar. I don't remember which! I had people for that!
radio.done: The door! It's opening!

objectives.label: Walk the minister to the helipad

radio.speaker: Marlowe
radio.start: Stay close to me. You don't understand, LANTERN was meant to save people. It was meant to...
radio.done: Is that the chopper? Tell me that's the chopper.

objectives.label: Light the four corners of the pad

radio.speaker: Kestrel
radio.start: Kestrel. I can't see the pad in this fog. Landing lights on posts at each corner: stand at each one till it comes on. And something big is coming through the hedges!
radio.done: I see four lights. Coming round.

objectives.label: Everyone on the chopper

radio.speaker: Kestrel
radio.start: On the skids. Thirty-five seconds!

objectives.label: Optional: put down 200

notes.title: A letter on the study desk
notes.text: Sana is right that BRIAR is not ready. She is wrong that it matters. The fields were sprayed; the Treasury has its harvest figures. LANTERN will contain any spread: a serum we can make ourselves, without her. If it fails, Ashgate is small. Ashgate can be burned.

notes.title: Diary, last page
notes.text: Day 7 in the safe room. LANTERN did not work. Penn turned in the lab and they could not stop him. The child, the Pryce child, is the answer. Sana has her. Sana has always had the answer. I gave the codes to no one. I will give them to whoever opens this door.

notes.title: In the gardener's bothy
notes.text: Mr Penn from the Glasshouse came here last spring with cuttings from the trial crop, said the minister wanted them in the rose beds. Roses died. Then the hedges. Something lives in the hedges now. It's big, and it waits.

name: Terminus
description: Dr Vey has worked out the cure from Mila Pryce's blood, and it can only be made in Halden's sealed lab at the end of the metro. Take Marlowe's codes down through the burning tunnel, make the cure and carry it to the surface before the bombers reach Harrow.
briefing: This is it. Dr Vey has the cultures from the depot, Penn's blood from the hospital and Mila's from the train. With Marlowe's codes, Halden's synthesiser in Sub-Level 4 can make the cure.
The way down is through the dark station and a stalled train in the tunnel, and the train is on fire. The lab's airlock purges slowly and its jammer kills your kit while it does.

Start the synthesiser from both consoles and keep it alive while it runs: everything down there will come for it. Then carry the canister up to the roof pad. The government has given up on Harrow. Bombers are over the city in thirteen minutes.
debrief: The cure is on the bird, and so is Dr Vey. Mila is waiting at the airfield. Behind you, Harrow lights up white. The Rotline is broken. So is the rot.

objectives.label: Take both stairheads at the station entrance

radio.speaker: Kestrel
radio.start: Kestrel. Dropping you by the stadium. Two stairheads down into the station: take both and hold them till the street gives up.
radio.done: Station doors are open. No going back up after this.

objectives.label: Open the track gates from the station master's booth

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Okafor. The track gates are run from the booth on the west side of the hall. It's dark down there. Lights on.
radio.done: Gates are up. Down you go.

objectives.label: Through the stalled train before the fire takes the tunnel

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: The dead train's fuel is burning and the fire is coming up the platform behind you! Through the carriages and out the far end!
radio.done: You're through. The fire's settling.

objectives.label: Hold the airlock while it purges

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: Marlowe's codes are in. The airlock purges slowly and the lab's jammer is on: your kit is dead for forty-five seconds. Barricades you placed before still stand.
radio.done: Airlock's open. Sub-Level 4.

objectives.label: Start the synthesiser from both consoles

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: Two consoles, one in a west lab, one in an east lab. Mila's bloodwork goes in, the cure comes out. Start them both.
radio.done: It's running! Lab four is open: the synthesiser's in there, and they know.

objectives.label: Keep the synthesiser running

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: Sixty seconds. If it stops, we start again. Two Brutes in the corridor! Hold E on it if they get through!
radio.done: Done! It works. Edwin's blight can be reversed!

objectives.label: Carry the cure up to the roof pad

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: The canister on the bench. Every dose there is. Whoever carries it has a pistol and nothing else, so the rest of you, walk with them.
radio.done: Cure's on the pad.

objectives.label: Everyone on the bird

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Okafor. Bombers are at the perimeter. Forty-five seconds to payload, Lantern. Get off that roof!

objectives.label: Optional: put down 200
Optional: burn the brood nest in the dead train

notes.title: Station announcement script
notes.text: This station is closed by order of the Ministry. Halden Agritech personnel only beyond this point. Passengers are asked to make their way to the surface. (Scrawled across it:) THERE IS NO SURFACE LEFT

notes.title: Staff room noticeboard
notes.text: Lights out at 2300 every night now. Halden says the trains carry "seed stock" to the lab at the end of the line. We've stopped asking. Kettle's broken. Somebody bricked the door from the outside. Not funny, Gary.

notes.title: Lab journal, last entry
notes.text: Mila's antibodies bind BRIAR's coat protein and the whole thing falls apart, like pulling one thread out of a jumper. I made this. I can unmake it. If you are reading this and I am not here, start the synthesiser and take the canister. Tell Mila she saved everyone.

briefing: The food depot is boiling over. Three minutes: kill everything that moves.
